exact_statement: Under A1-A2, P_hat_i is absolutely continuous with respect to P_star_i and KL(p_hat^{i+1} || q_i) <= KL(P_hat_i || P_star_i) = 0.5 * eps_hat_i^2.
quantifiers: Every generation i for which A1 and A2 hold.
pass_condition: The independent rule checker accepts the complete A1-A2 derivation with coefficient exactly 1/2; rejects a coefficient-corrupted certificate; the cumulative runner exits zero; and both endpoint-KL estimators' 95% upper values remain below the discrete path-KL budget plus the declared discretization tolerance on all 10D GMM configurations.
failure_condition: Any proof dependency is missing, the exact coefficient changes, the negative control passes, or a calibrated endpoint estimate exceeds the path budget.
verdict_rule: VERIFIED requires the proof certificate. The finite GMM experiment alone is only corroboration.
